Ready to explore Olympic sailing? The Olympic Pathways Camps are back in 2027!

US Sailing and Oakcliff are expanding opportunities for aspiring Olympians to get hands-on experience, connect with experienced coaches, and discover what it takes to pursue an Olympic campaign.

Miami, FL | January 8–10, 2027

Athletes will get on the water in three Olympic classes: the 49erFX, Nacra 17 and 470.

Whether you’re a college sailor, a recent graduate, transitioning out of youth sailing, or looking to explore a new Olympic class, this is your chance to take the next step.

Apply by November 20, 2026!

More opportunities are coming in 2027, including an Olympic Campaign Bootcamp at Oakcliff in Oyster Bay, NY, and another camp in San Pedro, CA.

Visit ussailing.org to apply or use the link in bio 🔗

⏪ #FlashbackFriday to our Olympic Pathways Camp with @ussailingteam

30+ Olympic hopeful sailors from across the US joined us at the @la28 sailing venue in San Pedro for 3 days of Olympic-class sailing, coaching, learning, and connecting. 🇺🇸🌴⛵

Sailors got to try the 470, 49er/49erFX, & Nacra17, learn from current campaigners and expert coaches, and hear firsthand what it takes to build an Olympic campaign.

We even finished with a pizza social 🍕 to help sailors meet potential teammates, make new connections, and maybe start planning their path toward 2032👀😉

Want to start building your Olympic pathway? We’re here to help! 📩 highperformance@oakcliffsailing.org
